requirements_summary: Moderate index: ~3M help articles + attachments (estimated 8-12M embedding vectors with chunking). Workload: very high QPS (1.5k steady, 3k-5k peak) with tight median latency targets. Primary flow: ANN retrieval (vector nearest neighbors) -> lightweight lexical filter -> cross-encoder rerank top-10. Targets: p50 <= 30ms, p95 <= 80ms, p99 <= 200ms for end-to-end rerank path. Cost target: <$0.001 per query (including embedding + ANN + rerank) or clear tradeoffs. Must support tenant isolation (multi-tenant SaaS), SSO, SOC2 compliance, audit logs, and KMS integration. Prefer hosted API but open to Dedicated if runway required.
use_case_summary: Customer-facing knowledge base RAG for a SaaS product: surfacing accurate KB articles and suggested responses inside agent UI and automated reply drafts. High QPS due to chat assistants and search bar on product UI. Must keep mistakes low — precision over recall for first results; reranking with cross-encoder is required for quality-sensitive queries. Also embedding-based semantic search used for fuzzy matches and typos.
index_scale_estimate: ~3M docs (~8-12M vectors after chunking), 150GB-400GB vector store depending on quantization
throughput_targets: 1.5k steady QPS, 3k-5k peak QPS; burstable to 10k for seasonal events
cost_constraints: Target <$0.001/query end-to-end; willing to trade some latency for lower unit cost (e.g., cheaper ANN + selective rerank)
suggested_poc_metrics: index build time, qps sustained with 95th percentile latency, CPU/GPU utilization, cost per 1M queries, recall@10 and rerank precision uplift
